narrative.headline: 2018 Jeep Grand Cherokee: the electrical system dominates owner complaints
narrative.summary: Owners filed 836 complaints with NHTSA. The electrical system is by far the most reported area at 40%, followed by the engine (14%), power train (8%), and service brakes (8%). No deaths are reported. The brakes draw fewer complaints than the top areas but the most crashes (11) and injuries (5) of any area, so they are worth a close look on a test drive.

issues.title: Electrical System
issues.blurb: The single biggest complaint by far: 336 reports (40%), including 6 with fire, 5 crashes, and 3 injuries. The fire count makes this worth checking carefully.
